data.rationale: The proposal captures the true path (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > vehicle card) and the vehicle-type parameter, but it hedges between alternate routes, lists vehicle options as examples, omits the facility parameter, and says "read the table" without concrete selectors, so it is only moderately automatable.
